name: golang-project-init
description: Scaffold a new golang project from an approved implementation plan — or from an idea, through brainstorming — in the shape golang-decompose carves toward: domains under internal/<domain>/ with model, repository, service and handler layers, role interfaces, stub implementations, wiring in cmd/<app>/main.go, a test per package, the repo files and the doc set — written by the coordinator under golang-code-style, tracked in a ledger, with hooks that keep a scaffold resumable and un-shippable until it is done.
